lede: Absolut Budget Workshop is a car workshop at WCEGA Plaza in Bukit Batok. Its own website says it has serviced and repaired Japanese and continental cars since 2016, with clear quotations.
services: Parts replacement, from batteries to tyres
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention reasonable prices for routine servicing, a computer scan to find what needs doing, only the changes that are needed, a wheel bearing replacement and staff who are easy to talk to.
faqs: What does Absolut Budget Workshop do?
Google Maps lists it as a car repair workshop.
